verdict.rationale: CoreWeave has a dedicated CKS quotas page. It documents viewing quotas in the Cloud Console, reading quota errors when a Node Pool exceeds its quota, and requesting an increase when more capacity is needed, which covers the see-and-raise flow directly. The evidence is a single summary-level doc page, so the depth of the limits and of the increase process is only implied. Missing for 10: published per-instance-type limit values and defaults, details of the increase process (channel, turnaround, programmatic or API path), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can see documented quotas and instance limits and raise them through a defined process

citations.quote: This page shows you how to view your quotas in the Cloud Console, how to read quota errors when a Node Pool exceeds its quota, and how to request an increase when you need more capacity.
how to request an increase when you need more capacity
